description: Golden expectations for the GitHub sign-in Brief 2.0 case (API lane).
comment: Structural + inferred-fact checks, never byte equality: results are sampled (see CUBICLE_EVAL_TRIALS). Required fields come from the live create_task schema at test time. An outcome is covered by one criterion that contains a term from 'any_of', or a term from EVERY group in 'all_of_groups' (each group is a set of alternatives), and none of the terms in 'none_of'; an outcome with 'none_of' is judged per clause (split at ';', sentence ends, ', and/but/while/otherwise' and 'and' before a negation), so one criterion may state the success and the failure path. Terms match at a word start, so stems such as 'navigat' work and 'authorize' cannot match 'unauthorized'; a term ending in '/' is a path that ends there, so '/' does not match '/settings/billing'. The success outcome names its destination (root / home page), so a brief that sends the user elsewhere or leaves the page vague does not cover it. No acceptance criterion may repeat a whole request sentence (tests/evals/live/_checks.py:brief_criteria_problems). To re-baseline, edit this file, bump the eval_case version in test_manager_brief_completeness.py, and explain the change in the commit; there is no regeneration script.
request: Please add a 'Sign in with GitHub' button to the login screen. It should kick off our existing OAuth flow at /api/auth/oauth/github/start and route the user to / on success.
